guidance: Compression is the default: answer YES when the arm is moving through free space — reaching, transporting a grasped object toward a target, retracting, broad sweeps, or pushing a door or drawer closed. Answer NO only when the gripper is in delicate or constrained contact: (a) grasping an object or inserting/aligning it precisely, or (b) closed on a handle, knob, or drawer-pull and drawing a door or drawer OPEN, so the object is moving with the gripper along a fixed hinge or slide arc — this constrained pull-open is not free space, even though the arm appears to be sweeping. Closing a single door or drawer with a push is still free space (YES). Decide from the camera views, not the task name; use the wrist view to confirm whether the gripper is actually engaged on a handle versus moving in open air.
